notes.title: Patch 1.1.35 is here!
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that made minions not appear when the first Boss invoked them.
- Now the achievement for completing the game tutorial is being delivered correctly. If you have not received it yet, all you have to do is play the first stage again.

That's it for now, folks! :D

notes.title: Patch 1.1.32: Partial gamepad support and more!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27770695/c16f453093a06b88670391165a7e21720e958879.png[/img]

Hello gamers! Here is patch 1.1.32. Check out the adjustments and new features on the list below:

- Partial gamepad support! Now you can play with those beloved analog sticks.
- New ultra secret achievement! Can you find it?

- The first Boss is now a little easyer to defeat.
- Zugs "wiped out" counter bug fixed. If you don't desintegrate any of them, it shows as zero on the final match stats and no longer four.
- Minor typo fix.

That's it for now. And let's ZAP some ZUGS!

notes.title: The first hotfix is out. Check it out!
